newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela foreign reserves fall to $15.549 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela foreign reserves fall to $15.549 bln.

text.p: Venezuela's total foreign reserves fell $266 million, or 1.7 percent, in the week to March 10 to $15.549 billion, according to new figures released by the central bank.
Reserves were down from $15.815 billion on March 3, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed.
Since the start of the year, reserves have risen $370 million, or 2.4 percent.
Reserves rose $5.5 billion, or 57 percent, last year to $15.179 billion and government officials have forecast they will grow to $20 billion by the end of 1997.
